operators.name: custom_threshold_mask
semantics: Implements the fused computation of the reference forward: per batch and spatial location, compute max over channel dimension (dim=1), compare with max_threshold; compute any(x > any_threshold) over channel dimension; combine masks with logical AND; output x where mask true else 0.
Input x is float32 CUDA tensor with shape [B, C, H, W] and arbitrary strides.
The reduction over dim=1 is performed exactly as torch.max(x, dim=1, keepdim=True) and torch.any(x > any_threshold, dim=1, keepdim=True).
The output has same shape, dtype, device and stride as input.
Boundary conditions: for each (b, h, w), the channel dimension C is reduced. Output element at (b, c, h, w) is x[b,c,h,w] if combined_mask[b,0,h,w] is True, else 0.

operators.name: custom_max_dim

returns.shape: max values shape as per keepdim; indices shape same

semantics: Matches torch.max(x, dim=1, keepdim=True): returns a pair (values, indices) where values is float32 and indices is int64.
Reduction is over channel dimension, preserving batch and spatial dimensions.
Indices are the positions (0-indexed) of the maximum value along the reduced dimension.
Supports arbitrary strides and handles non-contiguous tensors.

operators.name: custom_gt_scalar
semantics: Elementwise comparison x > threshold, returning bool tensor same shape as x.
Does not modify input.

operators.name: custom_any_gt
semantics: Matches torch.any(x > threshold, dim=1, keepdim=True): returns bool tensor indicating if any element in the channel dimension exceeds threshold.
Reduction dimension is 1, output shape [B,1,H,W].
Output is bool dtype.

operators.name: custom_logical_and
semantics: Elementwise logical AND of two bool tensors with broadcasting; in reference both have same shape [B,1,H,W].
Returns bool tensor of broadcasted shape.

operators.name: custom_where_mask
semantics: Matches torch.where(combined_mask, x, torch.zeros_like(x)): returns x where mask is True, else zero.
Broadcasting: mask shape [B,1,H,W] is broadcast along channel dimension to [B,C,H,W].
Output is float32 tensor with same shape as x.
Reduction over channel dimension, output values shape [B,1,H,W] float32, indices shape [B,1,H,W] int64.
Elementwise greater-than producing bool tensor shape [B,1,H,W].
First computes x > any_threshold (bool), then reduces over channel dimension with logical OR, output bool shape [B,1,H,W].
Elementwise logical AND of two bool tensors both shape [B,1,H,W], output same shape.
Broadcasts combined_mask from [B,1,H,W] to [B,C,H,W]; returns x where mask True, else zero; output float32 shape [B,C,H,W].
Final result is the tensor from step_005.
